style.name: builtin
style._comment: Package-shipped baseline. Loaded unconditionally by StyleConfig.load; user JSON files are deep-merged on top. All *_px values are pixels; the renderer divides by ptUnit_style at draw time. Opinionated per-type fills are the user JSON's job: they apply via overlay or defaults merge.

region._comment: Regions (region.*, L4) fill or hatch without a stroke by default.

decoration._comment: Shared sub-defaults for tick-marks on segments/angles and arrow heads on vectors/rays. Callers merge these into the relevant type as needed.

roles._comment: Style roles of a native document (appearance.<id>.role, 1.9.0a1); 'point' holds the keys of a point. Mirror of animageo.style.schema.ROLE_DEFAULTS.
